title: Fix the sliding-window rate limiter to match its documented spec
prompt: The rate limiter in ratelimit.py does not behave according to the spec in its module docstring, and at least one test in test_ratelimit.py fails. Fix ratelimit.py so the implementation fully satisfies the documented spec — including the window-boundary semantics, the rule that denied calls are not recorded, remaining(), and thread safety. The spec docstring is the contract: keep it intact. The tests encode the agreed-on spec and must not be weakened or changed. Run python3 -m pytest to check your work.

checks.needle: the check and the recording must be atomic
